entries.title: Caves of Qud
entries.definitive_edition: Caves of Qud on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best route because Caves of Qud is a deeply keyboard-friendly systemic roguelike, and PC has the strongest capture, update, and storefront support. macOS, Linux, GOG/itch, and Switch are valid access routes, but they do not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, GOG, or itch.io. Use Switch only if portable play is the priority.

all_releases.fidelity: Native 1.0 PC release with the most flexible keyboard/capture route and broad storefront support.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete route for a keyboard-heavy roguelike and the cleanest capture platform.
skip: useful native Mac route, but Windows PC remains the preferred capture/support target.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Linux 1.0 computer release, also suitable for Steam Deck-style play.
all_releases.reason: skip: excellent native Linux route, but Windows PC remains the simplest high-end capture target.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable console port released after the PC 1.0 launch.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong portable route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC and lower input/capture flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Switch is valuable for portability, but the PC route remains both complete and best suited to the game's systemic keyboard-heavy interface and capture needs.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 1.0 release is the full release after Early Access, not a remaster. The Switch version is a later port, not a separate edition with exclusive content.
